pet_notes: Compact full-body chibi Stella fan-art pet preserving her short layered mint hair with teal-tipped lower locks, round green goggles resting on top of her head, huge lime eyes with thick black circular outlines, freckles, reflective silver oversized lab coat, black choker, glossy black mechanical gloves, simple dark fitted trousers and compact black utility boots. Clever slightly tired scientist expression. Original fan art.
style_notes: Faithful simplified version of Studio Wrong polished Blender 3D-anime rendering; compact pet proportions; preserve face geometry and reflective silver/black materials; readable at 192x208; no cast shadow.
style_contract: Pet-safe sprite: compact full-body mascot, readable in a 192x208 cell, clear silhouette, simple face, stable palette/materials, and crisp edges for chroma-key extraction. Style `3d-toy`: Stylized 3D toy mascot with smooth rounded forms, simple materials, clear silhouette, and no photoreal complexity.
